newsitem.title: USA: White House still encouraged by budget response.
newsitem.headline: White House still encouraged by budget response.

text.p: The White House said Friday it was still encouraged by the Republican response to President Clinton's proposed budget in spite of some negative comments.

Spokesman Mike McCurry said officials were "absolutely" still encouraged because the budget had not been declared dead on arrival. He pointed in particular to comments from House Budget Committee Chairman John Kasich.

"John Kasich, who I think is one of the most entertaining guys in town, could have been very negative in his criticisms about the president's budget, and instead he elected to be indecipherable," McCurry said.
